verses.textZh: 神的仆人、耶稣基督的使徒保罗 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的仆人、耶稣基督的使徒保罗 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 神的仆人，耶稣基督的使徒保罗，凭着神选民的信心与敬虔真理的知识，
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ to further the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness—
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, for the sake of the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth, which accords with godliness,
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, a bondservant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect and the acknowledgment of the truth which accords with godliness,
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, a slave of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I have been sent to proclaim faith to those God has chosen and to teach them to know the truth that shows them how to live godly lives.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, a bond-servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, for the faith of those chosen of God and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
verses.textEn: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ to further the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness—

verses.textZh: 写信给提多，就是那在共同的信仰上作我真儿子的。愿恩惠平安从父神和我们的救主基督耶稣临到你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 写信给提多，就是那在共同的信仰上作我真儿子的。愿恩惠平安从父神和我们的救主基督耶稣临到你。
verses.textZhCuv: 盼望那无谎言的神在万古之先所应许的永生，
verses.textEnNiv: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who does not lie, promised before the beginning of time,
verses.textEnEsv: in hope of eternal life, which God, who never lies, promised before the ages began
verses.textEnNkjv: in hope of eternal life which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began,
verses.textEnNlt: This truth gives them confidence that they have eternal life, which God—who does not lie—promised them before the world began.
verses.textEnNasb: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised long ages ago,
verses.textEn: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who does not lie, promised before the beginning of time,

verses.textZh: 我从前留你在克里特岛，是要你办好没有办完的事，并且照我所吩咐的，在各城设立长老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从前留你在克里特岛，是要你办好没有办完的事，并且照我所吩咐的，在各城设立长老。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了日期，藉着传扬的工夫把他的道显明了；这传扬的责任是按着神－我们救主的命令交托了我。
verses.textEnNiv: and which now at his appointed season he has brought to light through the preaching entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior,
verses.textEnEsv: and at the proper time manifested in his word through the preaching with which I have been entrusted by the command of God our Savior;
verses.textEnNkjv: but has in due time manifested His word through preaching, which was committed to me according to the commandment of God our Savior;
verses.textEnNlt: And now at just the right time he has revealed this message, which we announce to everyone. It is by the command of God our Savior that I have been entrusted with this work for him.
verses.textEnNasb: but at the proper time revealed His word in the proclamation with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior;
verses.textEn: and which now at his appointed season he has brought to light through the preaching entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior,

verses.textZh: 如果有人无可指摘，只作一个妻子的丈夫，儿女都信主，也没有人控告他们放荡或不受约束，才可以作长老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人无可指摘，只作一个妻子的丈夫，儿女都信主，也没有人控告他们放荡或不受约束，才可以作长老。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在写信给提多，就是照着我们共信之道作我真儿子的。愿恩惠、平安从父神和我们的救主基督耶稣归与你！
verses.textEnNiv: To Titus, my true son in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
verses.textEnEsv: To Titus, my true child in a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Titus, a true son in our common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing to Titus, my true son in the faith that we share. May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: To Titus, my true son in a common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
verses.textEn: To Titus, my true son in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

verses.textZh: 因为监督是神的管家，所以必须无可指摘、不任性、不随便动怒、不好酒、不打人、不贪不义之财；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为监督是神的管家，所以必须无可指摘、不任性、不随便动怒、不好酒、不打人、不贪不义之财；
verses.textZhCuv: 我从前留你在克里特，是要你将那没有办完的事都办整齐了，又照我所吩咐你的，在各城设立长老。
verses.textEnNiv: The reason I left you in Crete was that you might put in order what was left unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
verses.textEnEsv: This is why I left you in Crete, so that you might put what remained into order, and appoint elders in every town as I directed you—
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason I left you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are lacking, and appoint elders in every city as I commanded you—
verses.textEnNlt: I left you on the island of Crete so you could complete our work there and appoint elders in each town as I instructed you.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason I left you in Crete, that you would set in order what remains and appoint elders in every city as I directed you,
verses.textEn: The reason I left you in Crete was that you might put in order what was left unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

verses.textZh: 却要接待客旅、喜爱良善、自律、公正、圣洁、自制，
verses.textZhCnvs: 却要接待客旅、喜爱良善、自律、公正、圣洁、自制，
verses.textZhCuv: 若有无可指责的人，只作一个妇人的丈夫，儿女也是信主的，没有人告他们是放荡不服约束的，就可以设立。
verses.textEnNiv: An elder must be blameless, faithful to his wife, a man whose children believe and are not open to the charge of being wild and disobedient.
verses.textEnEsv: if anyone is above reproach, the husband of one wife, and his children are believers and not open to the charge of debauchery or insubordination.
verses.textEnNkjv: if a man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of dissipation or insubordination.
verses.textEnNlt: An elder must live a blameless life. He must be faithful to his wife, and his children must be believers who don’t have a reputation for being wild or rebellious.
verses.textEnNasb: namely, if any man is beyond reproach, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, not accused of indecent behavior or rebellion.
verses.textEn: An elder must be blameless, faithful to his wife, a man whose children believe and are not open to the charge of being wild and disobedient.

verses.textZh: 坚守那合乎教义、可靠的真道，好使他能够用纯正的道理劝勉人，并且能够折服反对的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 坚守那合乎教义、可靠的真道，好使他能够用纯正的道理劝勉人，并且能够折服反对的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 监督既是神的管家，必须无可指责，不任性，不暴躁，不因酒滋事，不打人，不贪无义之财；
verses.textEnNiv: Since an overseer manages God’s household, he must be blameless—not overbearing, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not pursuing dishonest gain.
verses.textEnEsv: For an overseer, as God’s steward, must be above reproach. He must not be arrogant or quick-tempered or a drunkard or violent or greedy for gain,
verses.textEnNkjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as a steward of God, not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for money,
verses.textEnNlt: A church leader is a manager of God’s household, so he must live a blameless life. He must not be arrogant or quick-tempered; he must not be a heavy drinker, violent, or dishonest with money.
verses.textEnNasb: For the overseer must be beyond reproach as God’s steward, not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not overindulging in wine, not a bully, not greedy for money,
verses.textEn: Since an overseer manages God’s household, he must be blameless—not overbearing, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not pursuing dishonest gain.

verses.textZh: 因为有许多不受约束、好讲空话和欺骗人的，尤其是那些守割礼的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有许多不受约束、好讲空话和欺骗人的，尤其是那些守割礼的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 乐意接待远人，好善，庄重，公平，圣洁自持；
verses.textEnNiv: Rather, he must be hospitable, one who loves what is good, who is self-controlled, upright, holy and disciplined.
verses.textEnEsv: but hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.
verses.textEnNkjv: but hospitable, a lover of what is good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled,
verses.textEnNlt: Rather, he must enjoy having guests in his home, and he must love what is good. He must live wisely and be just. He must live a devout and disciplined life.
verses.textEnNasb: but hospitable, loving what is good, self-controlled, righteous, holy, disciplined,
verses.textEn: Rather, he must be hospitable, one who loves what is good, who is self-controlled, upright, holy and disciplined.

verses.textZh: 他们为了可耻的利益，教训一些不应该教导的事，败坏人的全家，你务要堵住他们的嘴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们为了可耻的利益，教训一些不应该教导的事，败坏人的全家，你务要堵住他们的嘴。
verses.textZhCuv: 坚守所教真实的道理，就能将纯正的教训劝化人，又能把争辩的人驳倒了。
verses.textEnNiv: He must hold firmly to the trustworthy message as it has been taught, so that he can encourage others by sound doctrine and refute those who oppose it.
verses.textEnEsv: He must hold firm to the trustworthy word as taught, so that he may be able to give instruction in sound doctrine and also to rebuke those who contradict it.
verses.textEnNkjv: holding fast the faithful word as he has been taught, that he may be able, by sound doctrine, both to exhort and convict those who contradict.
verses.textEnNlt: He must have a strong belief in the trustworthy message he was taught; then he will be able to encourage others with wholesome teaching and show those who oppose it where they are wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: holding firmly the faithful word which is in accordance with the teaching, so that he will be able both to exhort in sound doctrine and to refute those who contradict it.
verses.textEn: He must hold firmly to the trustworthy message as it has been taught, so that he can encourage others by sound doctrine and refute those who oppose it.

verses.textZh: 有一个克里特本地的先知说过："克里特人是常常说谎的，是恶兽，好吃懒作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个克里特本地的先知说过："克里特人是常常说谎的，是恶兽，好吃懒作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有许多人不服约束，说虚空话欺哄人；那奉割礼的更是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: For there are many rebellious people, full of meaningless talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision group.
verses.textEnEsv: For there are many who are insubordinate, empty talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision party.
verses.textEnNkjv: For there are many insubordinate, both idle talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
verses.textEnNlt: For there are many rebellious people who engage in useless talk and deceive others. This is especially true of those who insist on circumcision for salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: For there are many rebellious people, empty talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
verses.textEn: For there are many rebellious people, full of meaningless talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision group.

verses.textZh: 这见证是真的。为了这缘故，你要严厉地责备他们，好使他们在信仰上健全，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这见证是真的。为了这缘故，你要严厉地责备他们，好使他们在信仰上健全，
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人的口总要堵住。他们因贪不义之财，将不该教导的教导人，败坏人的全家。
verses.textEnNiv: They must be silenced, because they are disrupting whole households by teaching things they ought not to teach—and that for the sake of dishonest gain.
verses.textEnEsv: They must be silenced, since they are upsetting whole families by teaching for shameful gain what they ought not to teach.
verses.textEnNkjv: whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole households, teaching things which they ought not, for the sake of dishonest gain.
verses.textEnNlt: They must be silenced, because they are turning whole families away from the truth by their false teaching. And they do it only for money.
verses.textEnNasb: who must be silenced because they are upsetting whole families, teaching things they should not teach for the sake of dishonest gain.
verses.textEn: They must be silenced, because they are disrupting whole households by teaching things they ought not to teach—and that for the sake of dishonest gain.

verses.textZh: 不再理会犹太人的无稽之谈和偏离正道的人的规条。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不再理会犹太人的无稽之谈和偏离正道的人的规条。
verses.textZhCuv: 有克里特人中的一个本地先知说：「克里特人常说谎话，乃是恶兽，又馋又懒。」
verses.textEnNiv: One of Crete’s own prophets has said it: "Cretans are always liars, evil brutes, lazy gluttons."
verses.textEnEsv: One of the Cretans, a prophet of their own, said, "Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons."
verses.textEnNkjv: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, "Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons."
verses.textEnNlt: Even one of their own men, a prophet from Crete, has said about them, "The people of Crete are all liars, cruel animals, and lazy gluttons."
verses.textEnNasb: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, "Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons."
verses.textEn: One of Crete’s own prophets has said it: "Cretans are always liars, evil brutes, lazy gluttons."

verses.textZh: 在清洁的人，一切都是清洁的；但在污秽和不信的人，没有一样是清洁的，连他们的意念和良心都污秽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在清洁的人，一切都是清洁的；但在污秽和不信的人，没有一样是清洁的，连他们的意念和良心都污秽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这个见证是真的。所以，你要严严地责备他们，使他们在真道上纯全无疵，
verses.textEnNiv: This saying is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, so that they will be sound in the faith
verses.textEnEsv: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
verses.textEnNkjv: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
verses.textEnNlt: This is true. So reprimand them sternly to make them strong in the faith.
verses.textEnNasb: This testimony is true. For this reason reprimand them severely so that they may be sound in the faith,
verses.textEn: This saying is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, so that they will be sound in the faith

verses.textZh: 他们声称认识神，却在行为上否认他。他们是可憎的、悖逆的，在各样的善事上，是毫无用处的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们声称认识神，却在行为上否认他。他们是可憎的、悖逆的，在各样的善事上，是毫无用处的。
verses.textZhCuv: 不听犹太人荒谬的言语和离弃真道之人的诫命。
verses.textEnNiv: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the merely human commands of those who reject the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: not devoting themselves to Jewish myths and the commands of people who turn away from the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: not giving heed to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn from the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: They must stop listening to Jewish myths and the commands of people who have turned away from the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: not paying attention to Jewish myths and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
verses.textEn: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the merely human commands of those who reject the truth.

verses.textZh: 在洁净的人，凡物都洁净；在污秽不信的人，什么都不洁净，连心地和天良也都污秽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在洁净的人，凡物都洁净；在污秽不信的人，什么都不洁净，连心地和天良也都污秽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 在洁净的人，凡物都洁净；在污秽不信的人，什么都不洁净，连心地和天良也都污秽了。
verses.textEnNiv: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are corrupted and do not believe, nothing is pure. In fact, both their minds and consciences are corrupted.
verses.textEnEsv: To the pure, all things are pure, but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
verses.textEnNkjv: To the pure all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but even their mind and conscience are defiled.
verses.textEnNlt: Everything is pure to those whose hearts are pure. But nothing is pure to those who are corrupt and unbelieving, because their minds and consciences are corrupted.
verses.textEnNasb: To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure, but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
verses.textEn: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are corrupted and do not believe, nothing is pure. In fact, both their minds and consciences are corrupted.

verses.textZh: 他们说是认识神，行事却和他相背；本是可憎恶的，是悖逆的，在各样善事上是可废弃的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说是认识神，行事却和他相背；本是可憎恶的，是悖逆的，在各样善事上是可废弃的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说是认识神，行事却和他相背；本是可憎恶的，是悖逆的，在各样善事上是可废弃的。
verses.textEnNiv: They claim to know God, but by their actions they deny him. They are detestable, disobedient and unfit for doing anything good.
verses.textEnEsv: They profess to know God, but they deny him by their works. They are detestable, disobedient, unfit for any good work.
verses.textEnNkjv: They profess to know God, but in works they deny Him, being abominable, disobedient, and disqualified for every good work.
verses.textEnNlt: Such people claim they know God, but they deny him by the way they live. They are detestable and disobedient, worthless for doing anything good.
verses.textEnNasb: They profess to know God, but by their deeds they deny Him, being detestable and disobedient and worthless for any good deed.
verses.textEn: They claim to know God, but by their actions they deny him. They are detestable, disobedient and unfit for doing anything good.

verses.textZh: 至于你，你应当讲合乎纯正的道理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，你应当讲合乎纯正的道理。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你所讲的总要合乎那纯正的道理。
verses.textEnNiv: You, however, must teach what is appropriate to sound doctrine.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for you, teach what accords with sound doctrine.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for you, speak the things which are proper for sound doctrine:
verses.textEnNlt: As for you, Titus, promote the kind of living that reflects wholesome teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, proclaim the things which are fitting for sound doctrine.
verses.textEn: You, however, must teach what is appropriate to sound doctrine.

verses.textZh: 劝年老的男人要有节制、庄重、自律，在信心、爱心、忍耐上都要健全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 劝年老的男人要有节制、庄重、自律，在信心、爱心、忍耐上都要健全。
verses.textZhCuv: 劝老年人要有节制、端庄、自守，在信心、爱心、忍耐上都要纯全无疵。
verses.textEnNiv: Teach the older men to be temperate, worthy of respect, self-controlled, and sound in faith, in love and in endurance.
verses.textEnEsv: Older men are to be sober-minded, dignified, self-controlled, sound in faith, in love, and in steadfastness.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the older men be sober, reverent, temperate, sound in faith, in love, in patience;
verses.textEnNlt: Teach the older men to exercise self-control, to be worthy of respect, and to live wisely. They must have sound faith and be filled with love and patience.
verses.textEnNasb: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, sound in faith, in love, in perseverance.
verses.textEn: Teach the older men to be temperate, worthy of respect, self-controlled, and sound in faith, in love and in endurance.

verses.textZh: 照样，劝年老的妇女行为要敬虔，不说谗言，不被酒奴役，用善道教导人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，劝年老的妇女行为要敬虔，不说谗言，不被酒奴役，用善道教导人，
verses.textZhCuv: 又劝老年妇人，举止行动要恭敬，不说谗言，不给酒作奴仆，用善道教训人，
verses.textEnNiv: Likewise, teach the older women to be reverent in the way they live, not to be slanderers or addicted to much wine, but to teach what is good.
verses.textEnEsv: Older women likewise are to be reverent in behavior, not slanderers or slaves to much wine. They are to teach what is good,
verses.textEnNkjv: the older women likewise, that they be reverent in behavior, not slanderers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things—
verses.textEnNlt: Similarly, teach the older women to live in a way that honors God. They must not slander others or be heavy drinkers. Instead, they should teach others what is good.
verses.textEnNasb: Older women likewise are to be reverent in their behavior, not malicious gossips nor enslaved to much wine, teaching what is good,
verses.textEn: Likewise, teach the older women to be reverent in the way they live, not to be slanderers or addicted to much wine, but to teach what is good.

verses.textZh: 好提醒年轻的妇女爱丈夫爱儿女，
verses.textZhCnvs: 好提醒年轻的妇女爱丈夫爱儿女，
verses.textZhCuv: 好指教少年妇人，爱丈夫，爱儿女，
verses.textEnNiv: Then they can urge the younger women to love their husbands and children,
verses.textEnEsv: and so train the young women to love their husbands and children,
verses.textEnNkjv: that they admonish the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.textEnNlt: These older women must train the younger women to love their husbands and their children,
verses.textEnNasb: so that they may encourage the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.textEn: Then they can urge the younger women to love their husbands and children,

verses.textZh: 并且自律、贞洁、理家、善良、顺从自己的丈夫，免得神的道受毁谤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且自律、贞洁、理家、善良、顺从自己的丈夫，免得神的道受毁谤。
verses.textZhCuv: 谨守，贞洁，料理家务，待人有恩，顺服自己的丈夫，免得神的道理被毁谤。
verses.textEnNiv: to be self-controlled and pure, to be busy at home, to be kind, and to be subject to their husbands, so that no one will malign the word of God.
verses.textEnEsv: to be self-controlled, pure, working at home, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, that the word of God may not be reviled.
verses.textEnNkjv: tobe discreet, chaste, homemakers, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God may not be blasphemed.
verses.textEnNlt: to live wisely and be pure, to work in their homes, to do good, and to be submissive to their husbands. Then they will not bring shame on the word of God.
verses.textEnNasb: to be sensible, pure, workers at home, kind, being subject to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be dishonored.
verses.textEn: to be self-controlled and pure, to be busy at home, to be kind, and to be subject to their husbands, so that no one will malign the word of God.

verses.textZh: 照样，劝年轻的男子要自律。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，劝年轻的男子要自律。
verses.textZhCuv: 又劝少年人要谨守。
verses.textEnNiv: Similarly, encourage the young men to be self-controlled.
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise, exhort the young men to be sober-minded,
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, encourage the young men to live wisely.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise urge the young men to be sensible;
verses.textEn: Similarly, encourage the young men to be self-controlled.

verses.textZh: 无论在甚么事上你都要显出好行为的榜样，在教导上要纯全，要庄重，
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论在甚么事上你都要显出好行为的榜样，在教导上要纯全，要庄重，
verses.textZhCuv: 你自己凡事要显出善行的榜样；在教训上要正直、端庄，
verses.textEnNiv: In everything set them an example by doing what is good. In your teaching show integrity, seriousness
verses.textEnEsv: Show yourself in all respects to be a model of good works, and in your teaching show integrity, dignity,
verses.textEnNkjv: in all things showing yourself tobe a pattern of good works; in doctrine showing integrity, reverence, incorruptibility,
verses.textEnNlt: And you yourself must be an example to them by doing good works of every kind. Let everything you do reflect the integrity and seriousness of your teaching.
verses.textEnNasb: in all things show yourself to be an example of good deeds, with purity in doctrine, dignified,
verses.textEn: In everything set them an example by doing what is good. In your teaching show integrity, seriousness

verses.textZh: 言词要纯正，无可指摘，使反对的人因为无从毁谤，就自觉惭愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 言词要纯正，无可指摘，使反对的人因为无从毁谤，就自觉惭愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 言语纯全，无可指责，叫那反对的人，既无处可说我们的不是，便自觉羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: and soundness of speech that cannot be condemned, so that those who oppose you may be ashamed because they have nothing bad to say about us.
verses.textEnEsv: and sound speech that cannot be condemned, so that an opponent may be put to shame, having nothing evil to say about us.
verses.textEnNkjv: sound speech that cannot be condemned, that one who is an opponent may be ashamed, having nothing evil to say of you.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach the truth so that your teaching can’t be criticized. Then those who oppose us will be ashamed and have nothing bad to say about us.
verses.textEnNasb: sound in speech which is beyond reproach, so that the opponent will be put to shame, having nothing bad to say about us.
verses.textEn: and soundness of speech that cannot be condemned, so that those who oppose you may be ashamed because they have nothing bad to say about us.

verses.textZh: 作奴仆的，要凡事顺服自己的主人，讨他欢喜，不要顶嘴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作奴仆的，要凡事顺服自己的主人，讨他欢喜，不要顶嘴。
verses.textZhCuv: 劝仆人要顺服自己的主人，凡事讨他的喜欢，不可顶撞他，
verses.textEnNiv: Teach slaves to be subject to their masters in everything, to try to please them, not to talk back to them,
verses.textEnEsv: Bondservants are to be submissive to their own masters in everything; they are to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,
verses.textEnNkjv: Exhort bondservants to be obedient to their own masters, to be well pleasing in all things, not answering back,
verses.textEnNlt: Slaves must always obey their masters and do their best to please them. They must not talk back
verses.textEnNasb: Urge slaves to be subject to their own masters in everything, to be pleasing, not argumentative,
verses.textEn: Teach slaves to be subject to their masters in everything, to try to please them, not to talk back to them,

verses.textZh: 不要私取财物，却要显示绝对的诚实，好使我们救主神的道理，在凡事上都得着尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要私取财物，却要显示绝对的诚实，好使我们救主神的道理，在凡事上都得着尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可私拿东西，要显为忠诚，以致凡事尊荣我们救主－神的道。
verses.textEnNiv: and not to steal from them, but to show that they can be fully trusted, so that in every way they will make the teaching about God our Savior attractive.
verses.textEnEsv: not pilfering, but showing all good faith, so that in everything they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior.
verses.textEnNkjv: not pilfering, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in all things.
verses.textEnNlt: or steal, but must show themselves to be entirely trustworthy and good. Then they will make the teaching about God our Savior attractive in every way.
verses.textEnNasb: not stealing, but showing all good faith so that they will adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in every respect.
verses.textEn: and not to steal from them, but to show that they can be fully trusted, so that in every way they will make the teaching about God our Savior attractive.

verses.textZh: 神拯救万人的恩典已经显明出来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神拯救万人的恩典已经显明出来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神救众人的恩典已经显明出来，
verses.textEnNiv: For the grace of God has appeared that offers salvation to all people.
verses.textEnEsv: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation for all people,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men,
verses.textEnNlt: For the grace of God has been revealed, bringing salvation to all people.
verses.textEnNasb: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all people,
verses.textEn: For the grace of God has appeared that offers salvation to all people.

verses.textZh: 这恩典训练我们除去不敬虔的心，和属世的私欲，在今生过着自律、公正、敬虔的生活，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这恩典训练我们除去不敬虔的心，和属世的私欲，在今生过着自律、公正、敬虔的生活，
verses.textZhCuv: 教训我们除去不敬虔的心和世俗的情欲，在今世自守、公义、敬虔度日，
verses.textEnNiv: It teaches us to say "No" to ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright and godly lives in this present age,
verses.textEnEsv: training us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
verses.textEnNkjv: teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly in the present age,
verses.textEnNlt: And we are instructed to turn from godless living and sinful pleasures. We should live in this evil world with wisdom, righteousness, and devotion to God,
verses.textEnNasb: instructing us to deny ungodliness and worldly desires and to live sensibly, righteously, and in a godly manner in the present age,
verses.textEn: It teaches us to say "No" to ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright and godly lives in this present age,

verses.textZh: 等候那有福的盼望，就是我们伟大的神，救主耶稣基督荣耀的显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等候那有福的盼望，就是我们伟大的神，救主耶稣基督荣耀的显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 等候所盼望的福，并等候至大的神和我们 救主耶稣基督的荣耀显现。
verses.textEnNiv: while we wait for the blessed hope—the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnEsv: waiting for our blessed hope, the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: looking for the blessed hope and glorious appearing of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: while we look forward with hope to that wonderful day when the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ, will be revealed.
verses.textEnNasb: looking for the blessed hope and the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Christ Jesus,
verses.textEn: while we wait for the blessed hope—the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

verses.textZh: 他为我们舍己，为的是要救赎我们脱离一切不法的事，并且洁净我们作他自己的子民，热心善工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为我们舍己，为的是要救赎我们脱离一切不法的事，并且洁净我们作他自己的子民，热心善工。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为我们舍了自己，要赎我们脱离一切罪恶，又洁净我们，特作自己的子民，热心为善。
verses.textEnNiv: who gave himself for us to redeem us from all wickedness and to purify for himself a people that are his very own, eager to do what is good.
verses.textEnEsv: who gave himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for himself a people for his own possession who are zealous for good works.
verses.textEnNkjv: who gave Himself for us, that He might redeem us from every lawless deed and purify for Himself His own special people, zealous for good works.
verses.textEnNlt: He gave his life to free us from every kind of sin, to cleanse us, and to make us his very own people, totally committed to doing good deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: who gave Himself for us to redeem us from every lawless deed, and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, eager for good deeds.
verses.textEn: who gave himself for us to redeem us from all wickedness and to purify for himself a people that are his very own, eager to do what is good.

verses.textZh: 你要传讲这些事，运用各样的权柄去劝戒人，责备人；不要让人轻看你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要传讲这些事，运用各样的权柄去劝戒人，责备人；不要让人轻看你。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事你要讲明，劝戒人，用各等权柄责备人；不可叫人轻看你。
verses.textEnNiv: These, then, are the things you should teach. Encourage and rebuke with all authority. Do not let anyone despise you.
verses.textEnEsv: Declare these things; exhort and rebuke with all authority. Let no one disregard you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Speak these things, exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
verses.textEnNlt: You must teach these things and encourage the believers to do them. You have the authority to correct them when necessary, so don’t let anyone disregard what you say.
verses.textEnNasb: These things speak and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. No one is to disregard you.
verses.textEn: These, then, are the things you should teach. Encourage and rebuke with all authority. Do not let anyone despise you.

verses.textZh: 你要提醒他们服从执政的和掌权的，听从他们，随时准备作各种善工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要提醒他们服从执政的和掌权的，听从他们，随时准备作各种善工。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要提醒众人，叫他们顺服作官的、掌权的，遵他的命，预备行各样的善事。
verses.textEnNiv: Remind the people to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready to do whatever is good,
verses.textEnEsv: Remind them to be submissive to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remind them to be subject to rulers and authorities, to obey, to be ready for every good work,
verses.textEnNlt: Remind the believers to submit to the government and its officers. They should be obedient, always ready to do what is good.
verses.textEnNasb: Remind them to be subject to rulers, to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good deed,
verses.textEn: Remind the people to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready to do whatever is good,

verses.textZh: 不可毁谤人，要与人无争，谦恭有礼，向众人表现充分温柔的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可毁谤人，要与人无争，谦恭有礼，向众人表现充分温柔的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要毁谤，不要争竞，总要和平，向众人大显温柔。
verses.textEnNiv: to slander no one, to be peaceable and considerate, and always to be gentle toward everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: to speak evil of no one, to avoid quarreling, to be gentle, and to show perfect courtesy toward all people.
verses.textEnNkjv: to speak evil of no one, to be peaceable, gentle, showing all humility to all men.
verses.textEnNlt: They must not slander anyone and must avoid quarreling. Instead, they should be gentle and show true humility to everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: to slander no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing every consideration for all people.
verses.textEn: to slander no one, to be peaceable and considerate, and always to be gentle toward everyone.

verses.textZh: 我们从前也是无知、不顺服、受了迷惑、被各种私欲和逸乐所奴役，生活在恶毒和嫉妒之中，是可憎可恶的，并且互相仇视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从前也是无知、不顺服、受了迷惑、被各种私欲和逸乐所奴役，生活在恶毒和嫉妒之中，是可憎可恶的，并且互相仇视。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们从前也是无知、悖逆、受迷惑、服事各样私欲，和宴乐，常存恶毒 嫉妒的心，是可恨的，又是彼此相恨。
verses.textEnNiv: At one time we too were foolish, disobedient, deceived and enslaved by all kinds of passions and pleasures. We lived in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.
verses.textEnEsv: For we ourselves were once foolish, disobedient, led astray, slaves to various passions and pleasures, passing our days in malice and envy, hated by others and hating one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we ourselves were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful and hating one another.
verses.textEnNlt: Once we, too, were foolish and disobedient. We were misled and became slaves to many lusts and pleasures. Our lives were full of evil and envy, and we hated each other.
verses.textEnNasb: For we too were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, enslaved to various lusts and pleasures, spending our life in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.
verses.textEn: At one time we too were foolish, disobedient, deceived and enslaved by all kinds of passions and pleasures. We lived in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.

verses.textZh: 然而，到了神我们的救主显明他的恩慈和怜爱的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，到了神我们的救主显明他的恩慈和怜爱的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 但到了神－我们救主的恩慈和他向人所施的慈爱显明的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior appeared,
verses.textEnEsv: But when the goodness and loving kindness of God our Savior appeared,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the kindness and the love of God our Savior toward man appeared,
verses.textEnNlt: But— When God our Savior revealed his kindness and love,
verses.textEnNasb: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
verses.textEn: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior appeared,

verses.textZh: 他就救了我们，并不是由于我们所行的义，而是照着他的怜悯，借着重生的洗和圣灵的更新。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就救了我们，并不是由于我们所行的义，而是照着他的怜悯，借着重生的洗和圣灵的更新。
verses.textZhCuv: 他便救了我们；并不是因我们自己所行的义，乃是照他的怜悯，藉着重生的洗和圣灵的更新。
verses.textEnNiv: he saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy. He saved us through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnEsv: he saved us, not because of works done by us in righteousness, but according to his own mercy, by the washing of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to His mercy He saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: he saved us, not because of the righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy. He washed away our sins, giving us a new birth and new life through the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: He saved us, not on the basis of deeds which we did in righteousness, but in accordance with His mercy, by the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEn: he saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy. He saved us through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit,

verses.textZh: 圣灵就是神借着我们的救主耶稣基督丰丰富富浇灌在我们身上的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵就是神借着我们的救主耶稣基督丰丰富富浇灌在我们身上的，
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵就是神藉着耶稣基督－我们救主厚厚浇灌在我们身上的，
verses.textEnNiv: whom he poured out on us generously through Jesus Christ our Savior,
verses.textEnEsv: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
verses.textEnNkjv: whom He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
verses.textEnNlt: He generously poured out the Spirit upon us through Jesus Christ our Savior.
verses.textEnNasb: whom He richly poured out upon us through Jesus Christ our Savior,
verses.textEn: whom he poured out on us generously through Jesus Christ our Savior,

verses.textZh: 使我们既然因着他的恩典得称为义，就可以凭着永生的盼望成为后嗣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使我们既然因着他的恩典得称为义，就可以凭着永生的盼望成为后嗣。
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫我们因他的恩得称为义，可以凭着永生的盼望成为后嗣 。
verses.textEnNiv: so that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: so that being justified by his grace we might become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: that having been justified by His grace we should become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of his grace he made us right in his sight and gave us confidence that we will inherit eternal life.
verses.textEnNasb: so that being justified by His grace we would be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.textEn: so that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life.

verses.textZh: 这话是可信的，我愿你确实地强调这些事，使信神的人常常留心作善工；这些都是美事，并且是对人有益的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这话是可信的，我愿你确实地强调这些事，使信神的人常常留心作善工；这些都是美事，并且是对人有益的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这话是可信的。我也愿你把这些事切切实实地讲明，使那些已信神的人留心做正经事业 。这都是美事，并且与人有益。
verses.textEnNiv: This is a trustworthy saying. And I want you to stress these things, so that those who have trusted in God may be careful to devote themselves to doing what is good. These things are excellent and profitable for everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: The saying is trustworthy, and I want you to insist on these things, so that those who have believed in God may be careful to devote themselves to good works. These things are excellent and profitable for people.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I want you to affirm constantly, that those who have believed in God should be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a trustworthy saying, and I want you to insist on these teachings so that all who trust in God will devote themselves to doing good. These teachings are good and beneficial for everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: This statement is trustworthy; and concerning these things I want you to speak confidently, so that those who have believed God will be careful to engage in good deeds. These things are good and beneficial for people.
verses.textEn: This is a trustworthy saying. And I want you to stress these things, so that those who have trusted in God may be careful to devote themselves to doing what is good. These things are excellent and profitable for everyone.

verses.textZh: 你要远避愚昧的辩论、家谱、纷争和律法上的争执，因为这都是虚妄无益的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要远避愚昧的辩论、家谱、纷争和律法上的争执，因为这都是虚妄无益的。
verses.textZhCuv: 要远避无知的辩论和家谱的空谈，以及纷争，并因律法而起的争竞，因为这都是虚妄无益的。
verses.textEnNiv: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and arguments and quarrels about the law, because these are unprofitable and useless.
verses.textEnEsv: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, dissensions, and quarrels about the law, for they are unprofitable and worthless.
verses.textEnNkjv: But avoid foolish disputes, genealogies, contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and useless.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not get involved in foolish discussions about spiritual pedigrees or in quarrels and fights about obedience to Jewish laws. These things are useless and a waste of time.
verses.textEnNasb: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and strife and disputes about the Law, for they are useless and worthless.
verses.textEn: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and arguments and quarrels about the law, because these are unprofitable and useless.

verses.textZh: 分门结党的人，警戒一两次之后，就要和他绝交。
verses.textZhCnvs: 分门结党的人，警戒一两次之后，就要和他绝交。
verses.textZhCuv: 分门结党的人，警戒过一两次，就要弃绝他。
verses.textEnNiv: Warn a divisive person once, and then warn them a second time. After that, have nothing to do with them.
verses.textEnEsv: As for a person who stirs up division, after warning him once and then twice, have nothing more to do with him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Reject a divisive man after the first and second admonition,
verses.textEnNlt: If people are causing divisions among you, give a first and second warning. After that, have nothing more to do with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Reject a divisive person after a first and second warning,
verses.textEn: Warn a divisive person once, and then warn them a second time. After that, have nothing to do with them.

verses.textZh: 你知道这种人已经背道，常常犯罪，定了自己的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你知道这种人已经背道，常常犯罪，定了自己的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为知道这等人已经背道，犯了罪，自己明知不是，还是去做。
verses.textEnNiv: You may be sure that such people are warped and sinful; they are self-condemned.
verses.textEnEsv: knowing that such a person is warped and sinful; he is self-condemned.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing that such a person is warped and sinning, being self-condemned.
verses.textEnNlt: For people like that have turned away from the truth, and their own sins condemn them.
verses.textEnNasb: knowing that such a person has deviated from what is right and is sinning, being self-condemned.
verses.textEn: You may be sure that such people are warped and sinful; they are self-condemned.

verses.textZh: 我派亚提马或推基古到你那里去的时候，你要赶快到尼哥波立来见我，因为我已决定在那里过冬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我派亚提马或推基古到你那里去的时候，你要赶快到尼哥波立来见我，因为我已决定在那里过冬。
verses.textZhCuv: 我打发亚提马或是推基古到你那里去的时候，你要赶紧往尼哥坡里去见我，因为我已经定意在那里过冬。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
verses.textEnEsv: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there.
verses.textEnNlt: I am planning to send either Artemas or Tychicus to you. As soon as one of them arrives, do your best to meet me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to stay there for the winter.
verses.textEnNasb: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there.
verses.textEn: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.

verses.textZh: 你要尽力资助西纳律师和亚波罗的旅程，使他们不致缺乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要尽力资助西纳律师和亚波罗的旅程，使他们不致缺乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要赶紧给律师西纳和亚波罗送行，叫他们没有缺乏。
verses.textEnNiv: Do everything you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way and see that they have everything they need.
verses.textEnEsv: Do your best to speed Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way; see that they lack nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey with haste, that they may lack nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Do everything you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos with their trip. See that they are given everything they need.
verses.textEnNasb: Diligently help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way so that nothing is lacking for them.
verses.textEn: Do everything you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way and see that they have everything they need.

verses.textZh: 我们自己的人也应当学习作善工，供应日常的需要，免得不结果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们自己的人也应当学习作善工，供应日常的需要，免得不结果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我们的人要学习正经事业 ，预备所需用的，免得不结果子。
verses.textEnNiv: Our people must learn to devote themselves to doing what is good, in order to provide for urgent needs and not live unproductive lives.
verses.textEnEsv: And let our people learn to devote themselves to good works, so as to help cases of urgent need, and not be unfruitful.
verses.textEnNkjv: And let our people also learn to maintain good works, to meet urgent needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
verses.textEnNlt: Our people must learn to do good by meeting the urgent needs of others; then they will not be unproductive.
verses.textEnNasb: Our people must also learn to engage in good deeds to meet pressing needs, so that they will not be unproductive.
verses.textEn: Our people must learn to devote themselves to doing what is good, in order to provide for urgent needs and not live unproductive lives.

verses.textZh: 同我在一起的人都向你问安。请你问候那些因信而爱我们的人。愿恩惠与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 同我在一起的人都向你问安。请你问候那些因信而爱我们的人。愿恩惠与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 同我在一处的人都问你安。请代问那些因有信心爱我们的人安。愿恩惠常与你们众人同在！
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone with me sends you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all.
verses.textEnEsv: All who are with me send greetings to you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Everybody here sends greetings. Please give my greetings to the believers—all who love us. May God’s grace be with you all.
verses.textEnNasb: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all.
verses.textEn: Everyone with me sends you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all.
